policy_context.resource_basis: Distinct same-cap diagnostic after the inline-child candidate. Two analyzers with different dictionary content fingerprints open concurrently, synchronize while both remain live for PSS sampling, then release one at a time. This measures co-resident old/new analyzer memory and concurrent initialization effects; native cppjieba cache entries remain process-retained after Analyzer destruction. Compare only descriptively with the sequential two-version profile. Capture cgroup memory.stat/peak, phase markers, process PSS, and release observations. Exploratory memory/lifecycle evidence only, not a latency claim, stable capacity result, or architecture qualification. Any preflight/runtime/containment failure consumes the profile and is not retried.
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Each four-arm exploratory operation is descriptive only; shared-host pressure, one round per arm and test-scale workloads prohibit causal, qualification or architecture-win claims. ApplyBatch and Upsert call latencies have different units and must not be compared as equivalent tail samples.
